author: Mark Atwood
text: Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — code reads naturally on a first pass; idiom concerns are concentrated in MemoryBackend (clone-to-escape-borrow, Vec-as-set, tuple-key allocation, TYPE_NAME string dispatch) and in cross-handler duplication (.expect(serialize-infallible) and bool-arg parsing both repeated 8-13x in this crate and 30+x workspace-wide). Half the findings are workspace-wide patterns inherited from the canonical jmap-mail-server (.40, .41, .42, .44, .50) — fixing them requires changing the canonical first per the propagation rule.
